messages:
Maria (Sales): Heads-up — we pushed the price-list v3.1 to staging. Need clarity on the approval path for special terms on enterprise POCs. Does RevOps still gate commits under $50k? @Jon
Jon (RevOps): Quick clarifying q: policy currently lists $75k as the auto-approve threshold. Anything below goes to Deal Desk for review. We just had an exception yesterday, fyi. cc @dealdesk-bot :thinking_face:
dealdesk-bot: Deal Desk ticket #DD-4123 created: 'POC Special Terms — HealthCo' — status: awaiting RevOps triage. Link: https://tickets.example/DD-4123
Devin (Solutions Eng): Can we get a simple matrix? If a customer wants a 90-day reduced rate + modified data retention, does that always need legal? If yes, can Legal pre-approve a template to speed POCs?
Emma (Legal): Short answer: yes for retention exceptions. We can pre-approve a narrow template for 90/180 day POCs to avoid full review each time. Need the exact clause to review. @Devin can you paste proposed wording?
Devin (Solutions Eng): Proposed snippet: ```Data retention: Customer transcripts and logs will be retained for 90 days and deleted thereafter unless the customer requests an extension. No retention of raw model weights or internal system metrics.```
Emma (Legal): Looks good. Change 'deleted' wording: use 'permanently deleted' and add 'encrypted at rest' language. I'll draft the final template. ETA: EOD.
Maria (Sales): Ops question: do quotes keep a sku_version so older quotes map to the old price/SKU? We don't want existing quotes or offline spreadsheets to break when v3.1 goes live.
Jon (RevOps): Yes — we store sku_version on quotes. Caveat: the UI must not surface retired SKUs for new quotes. I'll raise a quick task with Eng to confirm UI behavior.
Devin (Solutions Eng): FYI Eng detail: we support backward mapping with `sku_map_v{n}` but it breaks when freeform sku names are used in manual quotes. Recommend we require catalog ids for all new quotes.
Jon (RevOps): Process tweak proposal: fast-track Deal Desk for POCs under $100k when Legal uses the pre-approved template. That avoids manual full review. Thoughts? :thumbsup:
Emma (Legal): I agree in principle. Legal will maintain the approved-template list and produce a sign-off signal. We can add a `legal_approved_template` tag to tickets so Deal Desk can filter.
Maria (Sales): If RevOps is good with that, I'll send a short Sales-facing checklist: 1) use the approved template, 2) select sku id from v3.1 catalog, 3) tag the deal with template and sku_version. Can we add those fields to the ticket form?
Jon (RevOps): Yes — I'll add `template_used` and `sku_version` as structured fields on the Deal Desk intake form today.
dealdesk-bot: Updated ticket #DD-4123: fields added: template_used, sku_version. Status: RevOps triage in progress.
Maria (Sales): Perfect, thanks. I'll hold off external comms until Legal drops the final template. Plan to push a one-paragraph note to #sales with the checklist before tomorrow standup. :white_check_mark:
